description: This file defines a PHP trait 'WorkWeekServiceTrait' within the 'OrangeHRM\' namespace, specifically in the 'Leave' module. It provides a method to retrieve a 'WorkWeekService' instance from a container, leveraging dependency injection patterns common in PHP applications. The trait also uses another trait 'ServiceContainerTrait' to provide container access.

methods.name: getWorkWeekService
methods.description: Returns an instance of WorkWeekService from the container, enabling other classes that use this trait to access business logic related to work weeks in the leave module.
